name: nan_container_scalar
template: {% set big=1e308 %}{% set inf=big*big %}{% set n=inf-inf %}{{n==n}}|{{n!=n}}|{{n is eq(n)}}|{{n is sameas(n)}}|{{[n]==[n]}}|{{(n,)!=(n,)}}

name: nan_container_distinct
template: {% set big=1e308 %}{% set inf=big*big %}{% set n=inf-inf %}{% set m=inf-inf %}{{[n]==[m]}}|{{(n,)==(m,)}}|{{n in [m]}}|{{n in [n]}}

name: nan_container_dict_key
template: {% set big=1e308 %}{% set inf=big*big %}{% set n=inf-inf %}{% set d={n:1,n:2} %}{{d|length}}|{{d[n]}}|{{n in d}}|{{d|items|list}}

name: nan_container_tuple_key
template: {% set big=1e308 %}{% set inf=big*big %}{% set n=inf-inf %}{% set d={(n,):1,(n,):2} %}{{d|length}}|{{d[(n,)]}}|{{d|items|list}}

name: nan_container_membership
template: {% set big=1e308 %}{% set inf=big*big %}{% set n=inf-inf %}{{n in [n]}}|{{n not in (n,)}}|{{n is in([n])}}|{{n is not in((n,))}}

name: nan_container_reverse
template: {% set big=1e308 %}{% set inf=big*big %}{% set n=inf-inf %}{% set it=[1,n,3]|reverse %}{{n in it}}|{{it|list}}

name: nan_container_items
template: {% set big=1e308 %}{% set inf=big*big %}{% set n=inf-inf %}{% set it={1:n,2:0}|items %}{{(1,n) in it}}|{{it|list}}

name: nan_container_changed
template: {% set big=1e308 %}{% set inf=big*big %}{% set n=inf-inf %}{% set m=inf-inf %}{% for x in [n,n,m,n,n] %}{{loop.changed(x)}}{% endfor %}

name: nan_container_shared
template: {% set big=1e308 %}{% set inf=big*big %}{% set n=inf-inf %}{% set a=[n] %}{{[a]==[a]}}|{{a in [a]}}|{{{'a':a}=={'a':a}}}
